decisionsTitle: «Golește lista» on «Cronometrare»: the phone's answered lines cleared, what has not left kept
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, two days before Saturday's race, with a picture of «Cronometrare»'s «Pe telefonul acesta» full of test presses the server refused before the start («cursa nu a pornit încă — notează pe hârtie ora: …»):** «cum pot să șterg înregistrările astea?». The lines live in the phone's own storage, the event's thirty newest answered ones (`ENTRIES_KEPT`, §986); nothing on the page removed them, so trying the line before the race left the list of race morning full of old refusals.

**Decision.** «Golește lista — rămâne doar ce n-a plecat» / “Clear the list — only what has not left stays”, a text button beside «Pe telefonul acesta», drawn only while a line the server already answered is there. One press removes from this phone, for this event, every answered line — saved, refused, a duplicate, undone — and keeps every press still waiting to leave, this account's or another account's left on the phone (`domain/finish-line.ts#withoutSettled`), so clearing the list never loses a finish. It touches only the phone: the results, «Istoricul sosirilor» and every other phone are as they were; a refused press's time to write on paper goes with its line, which is why the button says what stays. No question first: what it removes the server already answered.

**Not in this change.** Clearing the other phones: each clears its own.
changelogLine: - **«Golește lista» on «Cronometrare»** — beside «Pe telefonul acesta», one press clears the phone's lines the server already answered (saved or refused — test presses before the start among them) and keeps every press that has not left yet. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cronometrare» on a phone holding lines under «Pe telefonul acesta», when one of them is answered — saved, refused, a duplicate or undone — then a 44-pixel «Golește lista — rămâne doar ce n-a plecat» stands beside the title, and one press removes from that phone's storage, for that event, every answered line and keeps every press still waiting to leave, the signed-in account's and another account's; with no answered line the button is not drawn; nothing on the server changes (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Golește lista» on «Cronometrare» clears the phone's answered lines
